EXACT TITLE: "焰术师 · 烬绯"
EXACT ROLE LINE: "爆发施法 · 灼烧压制"
CHARACTER DESIGN: Adult female fire mage, deep-brown long hair, confident sharp eyes, crimson asymmetric split-tail battle coat over a charcoal fitted tunic and trousers, tall boots, black bracers, sparse antique-gold flame embroidery. Medium-length dark STAFF with open brass fire-cage tip. Preserve the reference arena fire mage's red-and-black identity. Strong flowing angular coat silhouette. 1. Exact heading "普攻 · 焰矢": Sharp staff thrust launches a compact tapered horizontal orange FIREBOLT with a clean trail and small impact.
2. Exact heading "Q · 爆燃印": She stamps the staff, drawing an orange telegraph on a CRACKED WOODEN BRIDGE. A small second moment shows an upward burst breaking two planks. Delayed floor burst and destructible terrain.
3. Exact heading "E · 焰跃": Airborne recoil jump: she moves UP-LEFT while a short fire cone blasts DOWN-RIGHT. Make opposing body-motion and fire directions clear.
4. Exact heading "R · 陨火天坠": Two-handed overhead invocation, one molten meteor descending toward a clear bounded orange floor telegraph. Long-windup casting pose; do not hide the hero.
Ensure all eight action key poses and all four skill cards are present and readable. The same adult hero must remain recognizable across all panels.

passive.name: 余烬

supplements.file: 07-焰术师与霜语者-被动与二段技能.png
supplements.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram / stylized-concept.
Create a polished high-resolution landscape GAME MECHANIC CONCEPT BOARD, hand-drawn dark fantasy matching the attached hero concept-sheet references. The references are character-identity and art-style references, not edit targets. Preserve each hero's EXACT face, costume, weapon, hair and palette.
Layout TWO HORIZONTAL ROWS, one hero per row; each row has a slim hero title, then THREE large illustrated panels: PASSIVE at left, FIRST CAST in middle, OPTIONAL RECAST at right. Fine antique-gold dividers, textured blue-black board, cream readable Chinese typography. At bottom of each row show a clear first-key -> timed-window -> same-key-again timeline with a small readable timer ring. All combat vignettes must be strictly SIDE-VIEW, with clear platform edges and full hero bodies. Grey dummies allowed only as targets, no extra selectable heroes.
Show effects and action poses, not long prose. Label PASSIVE panel "被动"; label first phase "一段"; label last phase "二段". Render the provided exact short names, timings and key badges. Make trigger, follow-up and window clear without excessive arrows or visual clutter. Recast arrows and clocks should be subtle but readable. Keep enough artwork space. No HUD, logos, watermarks, gore or fake technical editor.
Both rows equal visual attention. Every passive and recast has different visual construction and an occupation-appropriate body gesture. No generic recolored explosion reused between heroes.
